BiblicalUsage: Epigraphe is an inscription, a superscription — the words written on a thing. Whose is this image and superscription, Jesus asks of the penny: Caesar's. And over His own head on the cross the superscription read, This is the King of the Jews.
TheologicalSignificance: Caesar's image is on the coin, and Christ's kingship is over the cross, and I must decide which claim owns me. I believe the two inscriptions frame the whole story, and the superscription over Jesus is the truer one.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
